title: Chosen Before Time
story:
A little girl visited an animal shelter with her parents.

Many puppies were running around.

Some were bigger.

Some were stronger.

One small puppy sat quietly in the corner.

It had been overlooked by many visitors.

The girl walked straight to it.

She gently picked it up and smiled.

Her father asked,

“Why did you choose this one?”

She hugged the puppy and said,

“I didn't choose it because it was the best.

I chose it because I wanted it to be part of our family.”

The puppy had done nothing to earn a home.

It simply received love because someone chose it.

In the same way, God loved us before we could ever earn His love.

Before we were born, He had already planned to make us His children through Jesus Christ.

Our place in His family is a gift of His grace, not a reward for our achievements.
life_lesson: Your identity is not based on your performance. You are God's beloved child because He chose you in His love.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for choosing me and making me part of Your family.

Help me to live with confidence, knowing I am loved by You.

Remind me that Your love is a gift of grace, not something I have to earn.

May I live each day as Your child.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Do you sometimes feel you have to earn God's love?

How does it encourage you to know He chose you before you were born?

How can you live today as His beloved child?
verse: For He chose us in Him before the creation of the world to be holy and blameless in His sight. In love He predestined us for adoption to sonship through Jesus Christ, in accordance with His pleasure and will.
